style: Ancient Roman Republic and the eastern Mediterranean, 75 BC: Roman togas and tunics, simple head cloths and rough wool tunics for sailors, whitewashed Greek island towns, warm sunlight or oil-lamp light.

meta.angle: Julius Caesar was kidnapped by pirates, demanded they raise his ransom, bossed them around for 38 days, and then kept a promise nobody believed.
meta.hook: Open on Caesar ordering his own kidnappers to sweep the deck: 'Imagine being kidnapped by pirates, and then bossing them around like servants.'
titles: Caesar Got Kidnapped and Demanded a Bigger Ransom
The Pirates Who Kidnapped Julius Caesar Made a Fatal Mistake
He Was 25, Kidnapped, and Still in Charge
meta.description:
In 75 BC, pirates kidnapped a 25-year-old Roman nobleman. He laughed at their ransom, demanded they ask for more, and spent 38 days treating them like his servants. His name was Julius Caesar.

The Inventor and the Apprentice jump back to the Aegean Sea to watch the most arrogant hostage in history, and the promise the pirates thought was a joke.

Subscribe for a new jump through history every week.

thumbnails.description: The Apprentice cut out big on the right with a shocked face, next to young Caesar laughing his head off in a pirate cabin, with the text '50 TALENTS?!'
thumbnails.concept: A mascot's shocked reaction plus a surprising number creates instant curiosity: why would a hostage want a bigger ransom?
thumbnails.image_prompt: Close-up of a young Roman man in a white toga laughing with his head thrown back inside a dim wooden ship cabin lit only by a small clay oil lamp flame, no light bulb, two confused pirates behind him

thumbnails.description: Young Caesar standing calm and smug in the middle of a ring of pirates pointing curved swords at him, no text
thumbnails.concept: Pure dramatic tension and contrast: one calm man surrounded by weapons. The image alone asks 'who is this guy?'
thumbnails.image_prompt: A calm smug young Roman man in a white toga standing with arms crossed in the centre of a ring of ancient pirates pointing short curved swords at him, on a ship deck at sunset

thumbnails.description: Pirates on their knees scrubbing the deck while Caesar lounges on a crate like a king giving orders, with the text 'HE BOSSED THEM' at the top
thumbnails.concept: Role reversal is funny and unexpected; the text tells the twist in three words without repeating the title.
thumbnails.image_prompt: Wide shot: ancient pirates on their knees scrubbing a ship deck while a small young Roman man in a white toga lounges on a low crate like a king, pointing and giving orders, his whole body and face visible in the lower part of the picture

retention_notes: Hook: role reversal in scene 01, explained only from scene 06 on

Mascot reactions after each twist: scenes 08 and 13
Like & subscribe in scene 16, right after the capture payoff

scenes.image_prompt: On the deck of a pirate ship, a young Roman nobleman in a white toga sits on a crate like a king and points sternly while three embarrassed ancient pirates in head cloths scrub the deck on their knees in front of him

scenes.narration: [inventor|temperature:0.8|seed:2402] Welcome aboard, time travellers! Today we meet the most arrogant hostage in history.
scenes.image_prompt: Cozy inventor's study: wooden desk with brass gadgets and an hourglass, bookshelves, a big round brass time-machine door on the wall

scenes.narration: [nar|temperature:0.7] It's seventy-five BC, and a twenty-five year old Roman named Julius Caesar is sailing to Rhodes.
scenes.image_prompt: Wide view of a Roman merchant ship with a striped square sail crossing the calm Aegean Sea at dawn, small rocky Greek islands in the distance, seagulls

scenes.narration: [nar|temperature:0.7] Near the island of Pharmacusa, pirates swarm his ship.
scenes.image_prompt: Ancient Cilician pirates with head cloths and short curved swords climbing over the rail of a Roman ship from a small pirate boat, splashing sea
scenes.motion_prompt: the pirates climb over the rail and raise their swords, waves splash, the camera stays still

scenes.narration: [nar|temperature:0.7] The Cilicians were the most feared raiders of the Mediterranean.
scenes.image_prompt: A lineup of tough ancient Cilician pirates with scarred faces, head cloths and short curved swords standing on a wooden deck, menacing but cartoonish

scenes.narration: [nar|temperature:0.7] They set his ransom at twenty talents of silver.
scenes.image_prompt: Dim wooden ship cabin lit only by a small clay oil lamp, a pirate captain holding up two fingers in front of a calm young Roman man in a white toga sitting on a crate

scenes.narration: [nar|temperature:0.7] Caesar laughed in their faces. Twenty? He demanded they ask for fifty.
scenes.image_prompt: A young Roman man in a white toga laughing with his head thrown back while three ancient pirates stare at him in confusion, wooden ship cabin, warm oil lamp light

scenes.narration: [apprentice|temperature:0.9] Wait, he asked them to charge more? Who does that?
scenes.image_prompt: Cozy inventor's study: wooden desk with brass gadgets and an hourglass, bookshelves, a big round brass time-machine door on the wall

scenes.narration: [nar|temperature:0.7] His friends sailed off to raise the money, leaving Caesar alone with the pirates.
scenes.image_prompt: A small rowing boat with a few worried Roman men rowing away across the sea, a lone figure in a white toga watching them from the deck of a larger ship

scenes.narration: [nar|temperature:0.7] For thirty-eight days, he treated his captors like an audience.
scenes.image_prompt: A young Roman man in a white toga standing on a crate reading poetry aloud from a scroll to a group of bored ancient pirates sitting on the deck

scenes.narration: [nar|temperature:0.7] He read them his speeches, and called them barbarians when they didn't clap.
scenes.image_prompt: A young Roman man in a white toga scolding a group of sheepish ancient pirates who are clapping half-heartedly on a ship deck, lighthearted

scenes.narration: [nar|temperature:0.7] And he made them a cheerful promise. One day, he would come back and crucify them all.
scenes.image_prompt: A grinning young Roman man in a white toga wagging his finger at laughing ancient pirates who clearly think he is joking, sunset over the sea behind them

scenes.narration: [apprentice|temperature:0.9] He told them that? And they just laughed?
scenes.image_prompt: Cozy inventor's study: wooden desk with brass gadgets and an hourglass, bookshelves, a big round brass time-machine door on the wall

scenes.narration: [nar|temperature:0.7] The ransom arrived, and Caesar was set free. He went straight to the port of Miletus and raised a fleet.
scenes.image_prompt: A small fleet of Roman warships with oars and square sails leaving a busy ancient harbor town, a young Roman commander in a red cloak standing at the bow

scenes.narration: [nar|temperature:0.7] He found the pirates still celebrating on the same island, and captured every one of them.
scenes.image_prompt: Roman soldiers with shields surrounding a group of surprised ancient pirates around a campfire on a rocky beach at night, the pirates dropping their wine cups

scenes.narration: [inventor|temperature:0.8] If you never want to be on the wrong side of a promise like that, hit like and subscribe for the next jump!
scenes.image_prompt: Cozy inventor's study: wooden desk with brass gadgets and an hourglass, bookshelves, a big round brass time-machine door on the wall

scenes.narration: [nar|temperature:0.7] The pirates thought it was a joke. For Caesar, it was a promise.
scenes.image_prompt: A young Roman commander in a red cloak standing on a cliff at sunrise looking out over the sea, a line of captured pirate ships below, calm and determined

scenes.narration: [inventor|temperature:0.8] Lesson of the day: never laugh at a hostage's promises.
